about.metaDescription: QR Starr turns a QR card that travels with a gift into a personal digital greeting: a message, photos, video and a voice note, opened with one scan.
about.title: A personal greeting inside every gift
about.lead: QR Starr connects a physical card that travels with a gift to a digital greeting the sender creates on their phone. The recipient scans the card and the greeting opens: a written message, photos, a video and a voice note, in a design the sender chose.
about.stepsLabel: How it works, in four steps

steps.title: Pick up a card
steps.text: A partner shop includes a QR Starr card with your flowers, cake or gift.

steps.title: Create your greeting
steps.text: Scan the card and write a message. Add photos, a video or a voice note, and choose a design.

steps.title: Preview and activate
steps.text: See exactly what the recipient will see, then pay the one-time activation fee.

steps.title: They scan, it opens
steps.text: The recipient scans the same card and your greeting opens on their phone.

blocks.text: QR Starr is a digital greeting service. Each QR Starr card carries its own QR code which, once activated, opens one personal greeting created by the person giving the gift.
There is no app to install and no account to create. Senders and recipients use the camera and browser already on their phone.

items: Every card has its own QR code. Scanning a card that hasn’t been used yet invites you to create a greeting on it.
While the greeting is being written, the card is reserved for it, and only the device that started the greeting can continue editing it.
After activation, scanning the card opens the finished greeting.
One card holds one greeting. Once activated, a greeting can’t be edited.

blocks.text: Every greeting includes a written message of up to {{fact.messageMaxLength}} characters. The sender can also add:

items: up to {{fact.photoCount}} photos;
one video;
one voice note, recorded in the browser (up to {{fact.voiceMaxSeconds}} seconds) or uploaded as a file;
one of {{fact.themeCount}} designs, each with its own typography, colours and opening animation.

blocks.text: Before paying, the sender sees a preview exactly as the recipient will see it. File types and limits are listed on [How it works](/how-it-works).

sections.title: A physical card, a digital experience

blocks.text: The card links the gift to the greeting. The card travels with the gift; the greeting lives online. Because the greeting opens from the card itself, it arrives at the same moment as the gift.

blocks.title: The card is the key
blocks.text: Anyone who holds an activated card, or has its link, can open the greeting. There is no password, so the card should be given only to the person it is meant for.

items: A personal message with photos, video and voice that arrives together with a physical gift.
Nothing to install: everything works in the phone’s browser.
A preview before you pay, and a one-time price shown before payment. No subscription.
Available in Georgian and English.
A ready-made way to add a personal, digital touch to flowers, cakes and gifts.
Printable QR card batches, created and managed in the partner dashboard.
Card inventory and sales reporting in the partner dashboard.
Privacy by design: partners see whether a card has been used, never what a greeting says or shows.

blocks.text: Partnership terms are agreed individually. To become a partner, please [contact us](/contact).

items: Scan the card’s QR code with your phone camera.
If the card hasn’t been used yet, you can start a greeting on it. The card is then reserved for your greeting.
Your editing access is kept on the device you started on, for {{fact.editAccessDays}} days. If you switch devices or clear your browser data before paying, you won’t be able to continue the draft.

sections.title: Activation: when the greeting becomes available

blocks.text: Your greeting is activated **as soon as your payment is confirmed**. From then on, scanning the card opens it. Nothing is posted or shipped: the greeting is digital and opens from the card.

If a payment can’t be applied to your greeting, for example because it was already paid for in another browser tab, it doesn’t activate anything a second time and the extra payment is returned. See [Delivery and refunds](/delivery-and-refunds).

items: The recipient scans the same card. No app or account is needed.
The greeting opens in the design you chose, with your message, photos, video and voice note.
It can be opened again by scanning the card again.

blocks.text: The greeting is available for 12 months after it is activated.

items: **One card, one greeting.** A card can’t be reused or moved to a different greeting.
**No changes after activation.** Check the preview carefully before paying.
**The card is the key.** Anyone with the activated card or its link can open the greeting; there is no password.
**Editing stays on one device.** Before payment, editing access is kept on the device you started on, for {{fact.editAccessDays}} days.
**An internet connection and an up-to-date mobile browser** are needed to create and to open a greeting.
**Cards can be paused.** A card can’t be started while its partner’s account is paused, and greetings that break our [Terms](/terms) can be blocked.

refunds.metaDescription: How QR Starr greetings are delivered and activated, and when and how you can cancel or get a refund.
refunds.title: Delivery, cancellation and refunds
refunds.lead: How your greeting is delivered, what happens if you change your mind, and when you get your money back.

blocks.text: The activation fee makes your digital greeting available on one QR Starr card. The amount is shown in Georgian lari (GEL) before you pay. See [Pricing](/pricing).

QR Starr cards are handed out by our partner shops together with the gift you buy from them. QR Starr does not post or ship physical items to customers. Questions about the card itself, or about the gift, go to the shop that provided it.
The only amount QR Starr charges is the activation fee for the greeting, shown before you pay. The partner shop sets its own terms for the card.

Delivery is **immediate and digital**. Your greeting is activated on the card as soon as your payment is confirmed. From then on, scanning the card opens it; if you chose an opening date and time, the card shows a waiting screen until that moment and then opens the greeting. Nothing is sent by post.
If a payment fails, nothing is activated and you can try again.

items: **Successful payment:** the greeting is activated only after our server has verified the payment with the bank. Returning from the payment page does not, by itself, activate anything.

**Activation confirmation:** once activated, you see a confirmation on screen and can download a confirmation of your payment and contract (order reference, amount, the terms that apply and your consents). Scanning the card opens the greeting, or shows the waiting screen until the opening time you chose.
**Failed or cancelled payment:** nothing is activated and you can try again. If you still notice a charge, contact us.
**Payment still processing:** if the bank is still processing the payment, the screen shows that we are checking its status. Don’t pay again; we check the status ourselves.
**Charged twice:** if you are charged twice for the same greeting, the extra payment is refunded in full.

blocks.text: You can stop at any time before completing payment. Nothing is charged, and an unpaid greeting is never shown to anyone.
The draft stays reserved on the card and can be continued from the same device for {{fact.editAccessDays}} days.
Your greeting is digital content delivered immediately at your request, and it can’t be changed once it is activated.

Before paying, you separately ask us to start performing the contract immediately, by activating the greeting, and acknowledge that you thereby lose the right to withdraw from the contract. This also applies if you chose a later opening time for the recipient. After activation, the fee is therefore refunded only in the cases set out in this policy or where the law requires it.
This policy does not limit your rights as a consumer under Georgian law.
You receive a **full refund** of the activation fee, to the card you paid with, if:

items: **you were charged but the greeting could not be activated**, for example because it had already been paid for, or the card had been paused;
**you were charged more than once** for the same greeting: the extra payment is returned.
**a technical fault on our side** means a paid greeting was not activated or does not open, and access could not be restored without charging you again.

blocks.text: Please make your request while the greeting is available (12 months from activation); for a double or excess charge, at any time. This does not shorten any period set by law.

sections.title: When a refund may not apply

blocks.text: After activation, the fee is not refunded if you simply changed your mind, no longer like the greeting’s content, the recipient did not scan or lost the card, or the card or its link was passed to someone else.

If a greeting is blocked for breaking our [Terms](/terms), we assess the case individually and fairly, and decide whether any part of the activation fee is returned in line with the law. This never limits your rights under consumer protection law.

Once the activation fee has been refunded in full, including when a payment is reversed by the bank at the cardholder’s request, the greeting no longer opens from the card. Its content is not deleted automatically; you can ask us to delete it (see our [Privacy Policy](/privacy)). Returning a duplicate or excess charge does not affect a greeting that remains paid for.

items: Email {{merchant.supportEmail}} or call {{merchant.phone}}.
Include the card’s link (the address that opens when you scan the card), the date of payment and the amount.
Tell us briefly what went wrong.

blocks.text: We confirm that we have received your request within 1 business day and tell you our decision within 5 business days. Where the law sets a shorter time limit, we follow the law.

Refunds are paid back to the card you paid with, through the bank that processed the payment. We refund the full activation fee; partial refunds are not offered. We reply to the email address you wrote from and let you know when the refund has been issued.

After we have issued a refund, how long it takes to appear on your card depends on Bank of Georgia and on the bank that issued your card, so we cannot promise an exact date. If you don’t see the refund, contact us and we will help you check its status with the bank.

If you didn’t make a payment yourself, or you want to dispute a payment, please contact us as well as your bank; we can usually resolve it faster. If a dispute (chargeback) is opened, the bank’s decision applies. We may provide evidence that the greeting was delivered, such as when it was activated and opened, but never its content.
The service may be briefly unavailable for maintenance or because of a fault. A paid greeting is not lost during an interruption and opens again once the service is restored.
A greeting is available for 12 months after activation, not after its opening time. The end of that period is not a reason for a refund.

For a complaint, email {{merchant.supportEmail}} or call {{merchant.phone}} ({{merchant.supportHours}}). Include the card’s link, the date of payment and what happened. We review every complaint and reply through the same channel.
We reply to complaints within 10 business days. Where the law sets a shorter time limit, we follow the law.
Questions about delivery, cancellation or refunds: {{merchant.supportEmail}}, {{merchant.phone}}. Full merchant details are on our [Contact](/contact) page.

privacy.metaDescription: What personal data QR Starr processes, why, who can see it, how long it is kept and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: This policy explains what personal data QR Starr processes when you create, pay for or open a greeting, or use a partner account, and the rights you have.

blocks.text: The controller of the personal data described here is {{merchant.legalName}} (“QR Starr”, “we”).
Identification code: {{merchant.idCode}}. Registered legal address: {{merchant.legalAddress}}.
Contact address: {{merchant.actualAddress}}. Email: {{merchant.privacyEmail}}.
We have not appointed a personal data protection officer. For any question about your data, write to {{merchant.privacyEmail}}.

head: Whose data
Data
Purpose
rows: Message, photos, video, voice note and chosen design, including any people, faces or voices in them
Creating the greeting and showing it to whoever opens the card
Payment record: amount, currency, time, the bank’s payment reference and, where the bank provides them, the card brand and last 4 digits. Never the full card number
A random editing key stored in a cookie on your device
Making sure only you can edit your greeting before paying
When the greeting is opened, recorded against the card, not against you as a person
Confirming delivery, evidence in payment disputes, usage statistics
IP address, browser information and request logs
Security, preventing abuse (rate limiting) and fixing problems
Email address, sign-in data and actions taken in the dashboard
Running accounts, partner payouts and security

blocks.text: Legal bases for processing (Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection):

items: **Performance of a contract:** creating, storing and showing the greeting, the edit key, payment, refunds, answering you, and partner and administrator accounts;
**Legal obligation:** keeping payment records for accounting and tax purposes and complying with lawful requests from competent authorities;
**Legitimate interest:** security, abuse prevention, technical logs, the time a greeting is opened, usage statistics and evidence in payment disputes.

blocks.text: We do not sell personal data, and we do not use advertising or third-party tracking.

sections.title: Photos, videos, voice notes and messages

items: Your content is used only to build your greeting and show it to whoever opens the card.
Media files are kept in private storage and delivered through short-lived links, created each time the greeting is opened.
If your greeting includes other people’s photos, video or voice, you are responsible for having their permission (see our [Terms](/terms)).
Partner shops can’t see greeting content; they only see whether a card has been used.

blocks.text: QR Starr staff do not look at greeting content as a matter of routine. A small number of authorised administrators may open a specific greeting only when it is necessary: when you ask us for technical help with it, when the law or a competent authority lawfully requires it, or to handle a report that it breaks our [Terms](/terms) or the law. They access only what that purpose needs, and every such access is recorded.

blocks.title: The card is the key
blocks.text: Anyone who holds an activated card, or has its link, can open the greeting. There is no password or PIN. Give the card only to the person it is meant for, and don’t share photos of its QR code or its link.
The link in each QR code is long and random, so it can’t practically be guessed. But once it is shared, in a photo, a message or a social media post, anyone who sees it can open the greeting.
Before payment, a draft can only be edited from the device that started it.
Senders and recipients don’t need an account. Partner and administrator accounts sign in with an email address and password through Supabase Auth.

head: Provider
Role
rows: Database, storage of greeting media, and partner and administrator sign-in (servers in Frankfurt, Germany)
Email delivery to partners and administrators only (sign-in and invitation links)
Title, channel and thumbnail of YouTube links in a greeting (YouTube API Services), as an independent controller under the Google Privacy Policy
Card payments, as an independent controller under its own privacy policy

blocks.text: Data is stored in Germany (Frankfurt): the website servers by Render, the database and media by Supabase. We do not send emails to senders or recipients.

Supabase and Render store and process our users’ data in Germany (Frankfurt). Website and media traffic passes through Cloudflare’s network nodes in Europe (for users in Georgia, currently Sofia, Bulgaria). Germany and the other EU member states are on the list of countries with adequate data-protection safeguards approved by Order No. 007 of the Auditor General of the State Audit Office of 14 April 2026. Supabase and Render act only on our instructions, under data processing agreements that form part of their terms of service. Email sent through Resend goes only to partners and administrators and is processed in the United States, which is not on that list. We send it only with the written consent of each partner and administrator, given after we have told them about the risks of this transfer. Resend processes the data only on our instructions, under its data processing agreement.

If a greeting contains a YouTube or YouTube Music link, we use YouTube API Services. Our server sends YouTube only the video's identifier to get its title, channel and thumbnail. The thumbnail is then loaded in the viewer's browser directly from YouTube's servers, so YouTube receives that browser's IP address and standard request information. Opening the link takes you to YouTube. Google's use of this data is governed by the [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy).
We send YouTube nothing else about you, and we keep the title, channel and thumbnail address for at most one hour, only to avoid asking YouTube again.
Spotify links are plain links. We send Spotify nothing; Spotify receives information about you only if you open the link.
We use only what the service needs to work. We don’t use advertising or analytics cookies.

head: Name
Purpose
Lifetime
rows: Your private access to edit a greeting before paying; afterwards, it lets you see the “sent by you” note
Keeps an unsent message on your own device if the page reloads; removed once the message is saved
Partner and administrator accounts only: keeping you signed in and remembering the selected partner

blocks.text: These cookies are strictly necessary for the service to work, so we do not show a consent banner. If we ever add analytics or advertising cookies, we will ask for your consent first.
Card details are entered on the payment page of the bank that processes the payment. QR Starr never receives or stores full card numbers or security codes.
We keep a record of each payment (amount, currency, time, the bank’s reference and, where provided, the card brand and last 4 digits) for refunds, accounting and disputes.

Payments are processed by JSC Bank of Georgia on its own payment page, using the payment methods the bank offers there. From the bank we receive only the result of the payment: whether it succeeded, the amount and currency, the time, the bank’s order and transaction references, the type of payment method and, where the bank provides them, the card brand and a masked card number. We keep these records for as long as accounting and tax law requires.
We do not currently delete greetings, media, payment records or logs automatically.

An activated greeting opens from its card for 12 months. The end of that period does **not** mean the data is deleted automatically. You can ask us to delete your data at any time (see “How to make a request”).
We have not set a fixed deletion period. How long personal data is kept is determined by these criteria:

items: Greetings, their media and unpaid drafts are kept until they are deleted at your request.
Payment records are kept for as long as the law requires.
Security and technical logs are kept according to our hosting provider's log-retention settings.

blocks.text: If we set fixed retention periods, we will state them here.
Under the Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection you can ask us to:

items: tell you whether we process your data, and give you access to it or a copy of it;
correct, update or complete it;
delete it;
restrict (block) its processing;
transfer it, where that right applies.

blocks.text: Where processing is based on your consent, you can withdraw it at any time. You can also lodge a complaint with the State Audit Office of Georgia.

You can also object to processing based on our legitimate interest. We do not make automated decisions that have legal effects on you. Some rights may be limited where the law allows, for example when the law requires us to keep a payment record.
Write to {{merchant.privacyEmail}}. So that we can find a greeting without asking you for more personal data, please include the card’s link. We may need to confirm that the request comes from you.
If an activated greeting is removed at your request, it will no longer open from the card for anyone. Payment records are kept for as long as the law requires.

Data requests are handled by QR Starr through the email address above. We answer within the time limits set by the Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection and tell you if we need more time where the law allows it.

items: The website is served over HTTPS.
Greeting media is kept in private storage and delivered only through short-lived links.
Access to data in our database is restricted by role.
We never receive full card details.

blocks.text: If an incident affects your data, we notify the State Audit Office of Georgia where and within the time the law requires, and, if the incident creates a significant risk for you, we also inform you without undue delay.
Only people aged 18 or over may create and pay for a greeting. We do not knowingly collect payment or contact data from anyone under 18.
A greeting may, of course, be made for a child.
We will publish any changes on this page with a new effective date.
We announce material changes on this page at least 14 days before they take effect, unless a change is required by law.

blocks.text: The website and these terms are available in Georgian and English.

items: You are responsible for everything you put in a greeting. You confirm that you have the right to use every photo, video, recording and text you upload, including the permission of the people who appear in them.

blocks.text: This permission is free of charge and non-exclusive, is used only to provide the service, and ends when the greeting is deleted (backups may remain for a limited time). We never use your content in advertising or for any other purpose without your separate consent.

You must not use QR Starr to create or share content that:

items: is unlawful, or promotes or incites violence or hatred;
harasses, threatens or defames anyone;
is sexual content involving minors, or otherwise exploits children;
infringes anyone else’s rights, including copyright, trademarks or privacy;
contains malware, or links intended to deceive or cause harm.

blocks.text: You must also not try to access greetings or cards you aren’t entitled to, interfere with the service or its security, or use the service in a way that breaks the law.

The QR Starr name, logo, designs, animations and website belong to us or our licensors. You may use them only to create and view greetings through the service. Some fonts and design materials are used under third-party licences.

We may block a greeting that breaks these terms or the law, or when an authority lawfully requires it. A blocked greeting no longer opens from its card. To report a greeting, email {{merchant.supportEmail}} with the card’s link.

Each case is assessed individually and fairly, taking into account what happened and the applicable law. Whether any part of the activation fee is returned when a greeting is blocked is decided in the same way. Blocking a greeting never limits the rights you have under consumer protection law.
We work to keep greetings available at all times, but we can’t guarantee uninterrupted access. The service may be briefly unavailable for maintenance or because of a fault.

Activation and access are different. **Activation** happens when our server has verified your payment. **Access** is when the recipient can open the greeting by scanning the card: straight away, or from the opening date and time you chose. An activated greeting opens **for 12 months after activation**. The 12 months count from activation, not from the opening time, so a later opening time leaves less time to view it; an opening time can be set at most 360 days ahead. After that period the greeting no longer opens from the card. The end of this period does not mean your data is deleted automatically: see our [Privacy Policy](/privacy) for how data is kept.

If your payment went through but a technical fault on our side means the greeting was not activated or does not open, we check the payment and the activation and try to restore access without charging you again. If delivery cannot be restored, we refund the full amount. See [Delivery and Refunds](/delivery-and-refunds).
In that case, contact us. If we cannot restore access within 5 business days, we refund the activation fee in full.
Nothing in these terms limits liability that can’t be limited under Georgian law, including your rights as a consumer.
We are not responsible for the physical card, its loss, or someone opening a greeting with a card or link you shared.
These terms are governed by the law of Georgia. If something goes wrong, please contact us first; most issues can be resolved quickly.

If a dispute cannot be resolved with us directly, it is decided by the competent court of Georgia under the general rules of jurisdiction. Nothing in these terms limits the mandatory rights you have as a consumer, including your right to turn to the bodies responsible for consumer protection.
We may update these terms. The version in force when you paid applies to that greeting.
If the Georgian and English versions differ, the Georgian version prevails.
Questions about these terms: {{merchant.supportEmail}}, {{merchant.phone}}. Full merchant details are on our [Contact](/contact) page.

faq.q: Where do I get a QR Starr card?
faq.a: From a partner shop: the card comes with your flowers, cake or gift.

faq.q: Does the recipient need an app or an account?
faq.a: No. They scan the card with their phone camera and the greeting opens in the browser.

faq.q: Can I edit my greeting after paying?
faq.a: Before paying you can change everything, as often as you like. Once a greeting is activated it can’t be edited, so the preview is your final check.

faq.q: Can I start on one phone and finish on another?
faq.a: Editing access stays on the device you started on, for {{fact.editAccessDays}} days. If you switch devices or clear your browser data before paying, you won’t be able to continue the draft.
Anyone who holds the activated card, or has its link. There is no password, so give the card only to the person it is meant for.
